name: Final Fitting & Delivery
summary: A last on-body check, final pressing, and your garment is boxed or bagged for collection or delivery.
body: Before anything leaves the atelier, you try it on one final time. This is where we check hem length, button stance and overall drape under normal movement — sitting, walking, reaching.
Any last adjustments are made on the spot where possible, or within 24 hours for anything requiring re-stitching.
Garments are hand-pressed, packed in a breathable garment bag, and either ready for collection or arranged for local delivery.

seo.title: Final Fitting & Delivery — Our Process
seo.description: The last step at Lipek Fashion: a final on-body fitting, pressing, and delivery of your finished garment.
